title: Chicken Broccoli and Garlic Spaghetti
description: Tender chicken and broccoli tossed with spaghetti in a light garlic-olive oil sauce with Parmesan. Simple, satisfying, and packed with protein.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 25 min

ingredients.name: .5 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.original: 1.5 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.
Season chicken pieces with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through. Remove from pan and set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant and just golden — don't let it burn.
Add the broccoli florets and 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water. Cover and steam for 3-4 minutes until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp.
Add the drained spaghetti, cooked chicken, and butter to the skillet. Toss everything together, adding pasta water as needed to create a light sauce that coats the pasta.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan and lemon zest. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve immediately with extra Parmesan on the side.

title: Juicy Marinated Chicken Kabobs
description: Perfectly grilled chicken kabobs with a sweet and tangy marinade featuring grapefruit, soy sauce, and fresh ginger. The vegetables get perfectly charred while the chicken stays juicy.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 1 hr (marinating) | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast or chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast or chicken thighs

ingredients.name: grapefruit soda or lemon lime
ingredients.original: 1 cup grapefruit soda or lemon lime

ingredients.name: red bell pepper cut into 1-inch chunks
ingredients.original: 1 medium red bell pepper cut into 1-inch chunks

ingredients.name: green bell pepper cut into 1-inch chunks
ingredients.original: 1 medium green bell pepper cut into 1-inch chunks

ingredients.name: red onion cut into 1-inch chunks
ingredients.original: 1 medium red onion cut into 1-inch chunks

instructions: Cut 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Place chicken breast pieces in a gallon-size resealable plastic bag. Pour in 1 cup grapefruit soda, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger. Gently massage the bag to combine all of the ingredients and make sure all of the chicken pieces are coated.
Refrigerate and let marinate at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours.
Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before use or use metal skewers.

Prepared the vegetables by slicing 1 medium zucchini into 1/4-inch coins, and cut 1 medium red bell pepper, 1 medium green bell pepper, and 1 medium red onion into 1-inch chunks. Transfer to a large mixing bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/2 teaspoon onion powder to coat.
Preheat a grill to high heat (500°F). Remove the chicken from the fridge and thread onto skewers, alternating with pieces of the vegetables as desired.

Grill your chicken on a well-oiled grate, about ten minutes, until the chicken is cooked to an internal temperature of 165 degrees F, rotating every few minutes so that all sides receive grill marks. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Marsala
description: A classic Italian-American dish with tender chicken in a rich, savory Marsala wine and mushroom sauce.
meta: Serves: 6 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 35 min

ingredients.name: grams cremini or button mushrooms, sliced
ingredients.original: 450 grams cremini or button mushrooms, sliced

instructions: Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to about ¼-inch thickness. Even though the breasts are already thin, pounding ensures uniform thickness for even cooking and a more tender result.
Mix the flour, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder in a shallow dish. Dredge each chicken breast in the seasoned flour, shaking off any excess.
Heat the olive oil and 3 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken in batches, 3–4 minutes per side, until golden brown. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

In the same skillet, add the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter and sauté the mushrooms over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes until browned and tender. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 more minute.
Pour in the Marsala wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Let it simmer for 2–3 minutes to reduce slightly.
Add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a gentle simmer.

Return the chicken to the skillet. Simmer for 5–6 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (165°F internal temp) and the sauce has thickened. Taste and adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice.

title: Chicken Parmesan
description: Crispy breaded chicken cutlets topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. A classic Italian-American comfort dish.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin
ingredients.original: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with a wire rack.
Set up a breading station: beaten eggs in one shallow dish, and breadcrumbs mixed with 1/4 cup Parmesan, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in another.
Pound the chicken breasts to an even 1/4-inch thickness. Dip each breast in egg, then press firmly into the breadcrumb mixture to adhere on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the breaded chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy. Work in batches to avoid crowding.
Transfer seared chicken to the prepared baking rack. Spoon marinara sauce over each cutlet, then top with shredded mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Bake at 400°F for 15-18 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling and the chicken reaches 165°F internal temperature.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve immediately over pasta or with a side salad.

title: Chicken Rice Platter
description: Street-cart style chicken rice platter with turmeric-spiced basmati rice, perfectly marinated chicken, and an emulsified white sauce. This is the ultimate comfort food.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 20 min (+ 4 hrs marinating) | Cook Time: 45 min

ingredients.name: g (about 6-7 medium) boneless, skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 900 g (about 6-7 medium) boneless, skinless chicken thighs

ingredients.name: basmati rice, rinsed until water runs clear
ingredients.original: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed until water runs clear

instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl or bag, add chicken, toss to coat.
Marinate 4 hours minimum, up to overnight.
Melt butter in saucepan, stir in turmeric & cumin for 30 sec.
Add rinsed rice, coat in spices.
Pour in broth, season with salt, cover & simmer ~15 min.
Heat a heavy skillet or cast iron over medium-high until hot.
Cook chicken 3-4 min per side until browned and cooked through (165°F / 74°C internal temp).
Rest 5 min, then chop into bite-sized pieces directly in the pan, tossing in the juices.
Whisk mayo & yogurt smooth, add vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, seasonings.
Slowly whisk in cold water until creamy and pourable. Chill.
Plate rice, top with chopped chicken, add lettuce/tomato, drizzle with white sauce, serve with pita & optional hot sauce.

title: Chicken Shawarma Salad
description: A vibrant Middle Eastern-inspired salad featuring crispy spiced rice, tender shawarma-spiced chicken, fresh vegetables, and a creamy lemon-tahini dressing.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 45 min

ingredients.name: cooked rice, cooled (jasmine rice recommended)
ingredients.original: 2 cups cooked rice, cooled (jasmine rice recommended)

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1/2" pieces
ingredients.original: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1/2" pieces

ingredients.name: Optional: 1-2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup for sweetness
ingredients.original: Optional: 1-2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup for sweetness

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Add cooked and cooled rice to a baking sheet.
Toss with the olive oil and seasonings.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, tossing half way through (watch to make sure it doesn't burn).
While the rice is in the oven, season chicken and coat well.
Add olive oil to a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add chicken.
Cook until fully cooked through, then remove from heat.
Remove the rice from the oven and set aside.
Next, chop/slice all of the ingredients for the salad and add to a large bowl.
Add the chicken and crispy rice on top.
Blend ingredients for the dressing until smooth & creamy.
Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
Pour over the salad.
Toss and enjoy!

title: Chicken Taco Bowl
description: Seasoned chicken over cilantro-lime rice with all the taco fixings. A customizable bowl that's perfect for meal prep and weeknight dinners.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 20 min

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 1 ½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs

ingredients.name: black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.original: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: shredded Mexican blend cheese
ingredients.original: ½ cup shredded Mexican blend cheese

instructions: Season chicken thighs with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Cook rice in chicken broth according to package directions. Once done, fluff and stir in cilantro, lime juice, and butter.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F internal).
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice or chop into bite-sized pieces.
Warm black beans and corn in a small saucepan or microwave.
Build bowls: layer cilantro-lime rice, chicken, black beans, corn, pico de gallo, avocado, cheese, and sour cream.
Squeeze lime wedges over top and serve.

title: Life Changing Chicken Udon
description: A quick and flavorful Japanese-inspired udon noodle soup with tender chicken, aromatic broth, and fresh green onions. Simple yet incredibly satisfying.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: of small leek, cut in halves lengthwise then cut into 2 inches long pieces
ingredients.original: 1/2 of small leek, cut in halves lengthwise then cut into 2 inches long pieces

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken thigh, cut into bite size
ingredients.original: 1 boneless, skinless chicken thigh, cut into bite size

ingredients.name: serving portion of fresh frozen udon or dry udon noodles
ingredients.original: 1 serving portion of fresh frozen udon or dry udon noodles

instructions: In a sauce pan, combine dashi broth, soy sauce, mirin and sugar. Bring it to boil and let it boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Now, add sake, leek and chicken thigh. Stir to cook evenly, bring the soup back to boil then cook 3 to 4 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and the leek is nice and tender.

Cook udon noodles by following the sections of the package you are using. If you're using fresh frozen udon like me, start cook it when chicken is almost done. If you're using dried one that takes a few minutes, then start cook the noodles when you start cooking the chicken soup part.
Place cooked udon in a serving bowl and pour the chicken soup. Sprinkle chopped green onion and serve immediately! Enjoy!

title: Chicken Cilantro Wonton Soup with Mushrooms & Bok Choy
description: A comforting Asian-inspired soup with delicate chicken cilantro wontons, earthy mushrooms, and tender bok choy in a fragrant ginger-garlic broth.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: heads baby bok choy, quartered lengthwise
ingredients.original: 3 small heads baby bok choy, quartered lengthwise

ingredients.name: Bibigo mini chicken cilantro wontons (8 per person)
ingredients.original: 48 Bibigo mini chicken cilantro wontons (8 per person)

ingredients.name: Salt and white pepper to taste
ingredients.original: Salt and white pepper to taste

instructions: In a large pot, bring chicken broth, water, garlic, and ginger to a boil.
Add soy sauce, rice wine, and sliced mushrooms. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add bok choy and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Add wontons and heat through for 2-3 minutes (they're pre-cooked).
Remove and discard garlic and ginger pieces. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper if needed.
Ladle soup into bowls and top each with green onions, fresh cilantro, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito
description: Smoky chipotle-marinated chicken with cilantro-lime rice, black beans, pico de gallo, and sour cream wrapped in a warm flour tortilla. Better than the restaurant.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 25 min

ingredients.name: (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.original: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: pico de gallo or salsa
ingredients.original: 1 cup pico de gallo or salsa

ingredients.name: chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
ingredients.original: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced

instructions: Mix all marinade ingredients together. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Marinate at least 30 minutes (or up to overnight in the fridge).
Cook the rice: bring chicken broth to a boil, add rice and salt, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 18 minutes. Fluff with a fork and stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the marinated chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F). Let rest 5 minutes, then slice or chop into pieces.
Warm black beans in a small saucepan with a pinch of cumin and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave (wrap in a damp paper towel) until pliable.
Build the burritos: layer rice, beans, chicken, cheese, pico de gallo, sour cream, and guacamole down the center of each tortilla. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Optional: return the wrapped burrito to the skillet and sear seam-side down for 1-2 minutes for a crispy exterior.

title: Grilled Herb Chicken
description: Perfectly seasoned chicken with a fragrant herb crust, cooked in a cast iron pan. The combination of fresh rosemary, thyme, and sage creates an aromatic, crispy exterior while keeping the chicken juicy inside.
meta: Serves: 4 (24 oz chicken) | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: fresh rosemary, finely chopped (or 1½ teaspoons dried)
ingredients.original: 1½ tablespoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped (or 1½ teaspoons dried)

ingredients.name: fresh thyme leaves (or 1½ teaspoons dried)
ingredients.original: 1½ tablespoons fresh thyme leaves (or 1½ teaspoons dried)

ingredients.name: fresh sage, finely chopped (or 1½ teaspoons dried)
ingredients.original: 1½ tablespoons fresh sage, finely chopped (or 1½ teaspoons dried)

instructions: Combine all herbs and spices in a small bowl and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then rub all over with the olive oil.
Coat chicken evenly with the herb mixture, pressing it into the meat. Let rest 15-30 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat your cast iron pan over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes. Add a bit of oil if needed (the pan should be hot but not smoking).

Cook the chicken without crowding the pan - you may need to work in batches. For boneless breasts or cutlets, sear 6-7 minutes per side. For thicker pieces, sear both sides then reduce to medium heat and continue cooking until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing. The herbs will create a fragrant, crispy crust!

title: Lebanese Chicken and Rice (Rez a Djaj)
description: Rice with mince meat, chicken and assorted nuts - an authentic Lebanese dish featuring fragrant rice, tender chicken and a beautiful presentation topped with toasted nuts.
meta: Serves: 8 | Prep Time: 30 min | Cook Time: 1 hr 30 min

ingredients.name: g ground meat (lamb, beef or both)
ingredients.original: 200 g ground meat (lamb, beef or both)

instructions: Lightly toast the assorted nuts (pistachios, cashews, almonds) in a non stick pan on low heat until golden. Set aside.

In a large stock pot, add the washed chicken, onion, carrot, celery, cinnamon stick, cloves, bay leaves cardamom, peppercorns and salt with the boiling water. Bring to the boil then simmer for at least 45 minutes, removing any foam that comes to the surface.
As the chicken broth is simmering, soak the rice in a bowl of water for around half an hour and set aside.
When the chicken broth is done after 45 minutes, remove the chicken and drain the liquid over a fine colander into a pot.
Shred the chicken from the bone and keep the chicken breast in large chunks, cover and set aside.
In a wide casserole pan, sauté the chopped onion in a good drizzle of mild olive oil on low heat until soft and translucent. This may take 15 minutes.

Then add the mince meat, black pepper, 7 spice, cinnamon and around a teaspoon of salt. Increase the heat to medium and sauté for around 5-10 minutes until well browned, pressing with the back of a wooden spoon to break apart.

Drain the rice in a fine sieve and add to the mince meat along with the butter and sauté for a few minutes. Add 4.5 cups of chicken broth to the rice, bring to the boil and then cover with a lid then simmer for 20 minutes.
The rice is done when there should be no extra liquid, fluff it with a fork and add to a large platter.
Lay the shredded chicken on top and sprinkle with the assorted nuts.
Serve with a side of yoghurt or green salad.

title: Lemony Chicken Meatballs
description: Tender chicken ricotta meatballs with a bright lemon flavor, served over garlic spinach orzo. This dish combines Italian comfort with fresh Mediterranean flavors.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 30 min
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, gently mix together the ground chicken, ricotta, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, egg, parsley, lemon zest, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Form the mixture into 1½-inch meatballs and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake the meatballs for 20-25 minutes, or until golden and fully cooked.
Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a medium saucepan, then add the orzo. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until just tender.
While the orzo is cooking, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
Drain any excess liquid from the orzo and mix it into the sautéed spinach and garlic until well combined and creamy.
Serve the garlic spinach orzo topped with the baked meatballs. Garnish with lemon wedges for an extra burst of flavor.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Orzo
description: A vibrant one-pot Mediterranean dish with tender chicken, orzo pasta, fresh asparagus, kalamata olives, and feta cheese in a lemony herb sauce.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.original: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.original: 2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
ingredients.original: 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted and sliced

instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and half the oregano. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Cook chicken in 2-3 batches until golden and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes per batch. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and sauté onions until softened, about 5-6 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Add orzo and stir for 1-2 minutes to lightly toast. Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add asparagus pieces and reduce heat. Simmer covered for 14-16 minutes until orzo is tender and asparagus is crisp-tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cooked chicken, olives, lemon juice, lemon zest, parsley, and remaining oregano. Cook 2-3 minutes to heat through.
Top with crumbled feta and serve immediately.

title: Chipotle's Pollo Asado Burrito
description: Copycat version of Chipotle's Pollo Asado with achiote and habanero marinade, avocado crema, and pinto beans. Bold, smoky, and delicious.
meta: Serves: 2-3 burritos | Prep Time: 30 min (+ marinating) | Cook Time: 15 min
instructions: To a blender or food processor add the garlic, red onion, orange juice, lime juice, habanero, and achiote paste. Blend until smooth. **Important: set aside about 1/4 of the mixture for later.** Butterfly, pound, or slice your chicken breasts in half to thin them out. Lay your chicken pieces on a sheet tray (or in a bowl) and sprinkle with salt so that each piece gets seasoned, then pour over the marinade mixture and mix until all pieces are thoroughly coated. Marinate for at least 30 mins and up to overnight.
To a blender or food processor, add the avocado, sour cream, lime juice, garlic clove, and a sprinkle of cayenne. Blend until smooth, and add salt to taste.

For the beans, it's as simple as tossing a can of beans into a pot, adding a bay leaf, a sprinkle of ground cumin, and some salt to taste. Let it simmer for 10 minutes. For extra flavor, you can add a bit of achiote paste as well. While those are going, prep any final toppings you want for your burrito. Get out your favorite salsa or hot sauce, thinly slice some lettuce, grate some cheese, and lastly warm a tortilla until soft and pliable.

When you're ready to cook, rub a super thin layer of oil to a ripping hot cast iron pan or griddle. Sear the chicken until cooked through and nicely charred on all sides. Add the reserved marinade: chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces and spoon over some of the reserved marinade mixture to taste for additional flavor and moisture. Adjust with more salt and/or marinade if needed.

To make a burrito, top your warm tortilla with a base of the avocado crema, then follow with a layer of the beans, a handful of shredded cheese, about 200g of chicken (1/4 of the mix), a bit more avocado sauce, a spoonful of spicy salsa or hot sauce, and lastly a healthy handful of romaine lettuce before wrapping up. You should have enough remaining ingredients to make 2-3 more burritos.

title: Soba Noodles with Chicken
description: A delicious and healthy Asian noodle dish featuring tender chicken, fresh vegetables, and buckwheat soba noodles in a savory peanut sauce.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 15 min
instructions: Heat a medium pot of salted water to boiling on high. Wash and dry the fresh produce. Peel and finely chop the garlic and ginger. Peel and cut the carrot into thin matchsticks. Roughly chop the cilantro. Trim the ends off the snap peas. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.

When the water comes to a boil, add the soba noodles and cook about 4 to 6 minutes, or until tender, but not too soft. Drain and rinse under cool water to prevent them from sticking together. Set aside.

In a large pan (nonstick, if you have one), heat 2 teaspoons of oil on medium until hot. Add the chicken. Cook 4 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Transfer to a plate. Wipe out the pan.
In the same pan, heat 2 teaspoons of oil on medium-high until hot. Add the garlic, ginger, carrots, and snap peas. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened.
In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, and 1/4 cup of water. Whisk until smooth.
To the pan of vegetables, add the cooked noodles, cooked chicken, and peanut sauce. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, tossing frequently, until well combined and heated through.
Remove from heat. Stir in half the cilantro and the juice of half the lime. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide between plates. Garnish with the sesame seeds and remaining cilantro. Serve with the remaining lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!

title: Assyrian Kebab
description: Traditional Assyrian kebabs featuring spiced ground lamb with feta cheese, cilantro, and beets, served with a tangy yogurt-radish sauce.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: (100 g) brined white cheese such as feta
ingredients.original: 3 1/2 ounces (100 g) brined white cheese such as feta

ingredients.name: (50 g) finely chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.original: 1 cup (50 g) finely chopped fresh cilantro

ingredients.name: (120 g) radishes, grated, plus additional for topping
ingredients.original: 1 cup (120 g) radishes, grated, plus additional for topping

ingredients.name: (415 ml) plain yogurt (preferably a tangy and slightly thin type)
ingredients.original: 3/4 cups (415 ml) plain yogurt (preferably a tangy and slightly thin type)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 440°F (225°C). If you're using wooden skewers, make sure to soak them in water for at least 20 minutes before using to prevent them from burning in the oven. If you're using metal skewers, no preparation is needed.
In a large bowl, mix the lamb, onions, white cheese, cilantro, beet, garlic, sumac, cumin, and salt.
Divide the mixture into eight equal portions.
Press and wrap each portion onto the skewers, doing your best to make them of equal thickness and length.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet and bake them in the middle of the oven for 15 minutes.
To make the sauce, squeeze out the excess liquid from the grated radishes and discard it. Then mix the radishes with the yogurt, garlic, dried mint, and salt.
Transfer the sauce to a small serving bowl and garnish with radish and fresh mint.
To serve, add the yogurt sauce to each piece of bread, then remove the kebabs from the skewers and add two of them on each bread piece alongside the green onion. Garnish with fresh mint and parsley.

title: Beef Bolognese
description: A rich, slow-simmered Italian meat sauce with ground beef, soffritto, tomatoes, and a splash of wine. Best made in a big batch and served over tagliatelle or rigatoni.
meta: Serves: 6 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 1.5 hr
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion, celery, and carrot (soffritto). Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and the onion is translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Increase heat to medium-high. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no pink remains — about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Pour in the red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until the wine is mostly absorbed.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until it darkens slightly.
Add the crushed tomatoes, milk, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Bring to a gentle simmer.

Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1 to 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick and rich. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick. Remove the bay leaf. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve some pasta water. Drain and toss with the Bolognese, adding pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Serve topped with freshly grated Parmesan and fresh herbs.

title: Beef Shish Kabob
description: Juicy, smoky beef skewers marinated in a blend of Middle Eastern spices, grilled to perfection with colorful vegetables.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 20 min + 2 hr marinating | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: .5 pounds sirloin or ribeye beef, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
ingredients.original: 1.5 pounds sirloin or ribeye beef, cut into 1.5-inch cubes

ingredients.name: red bell pepper, cut into chunks
ingredients.original: 1 large red bell pepper, cut into chunks

ingredients.name: green bell pepper, cut into chunks
ingredients.original: 1 large green bell pepper, cut into chunks

ingredients.name: red onion, cut into chunks
ingredients.original: 1 large red onion, cut into chunks

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, allspice, cinnamon, black pepper, salt, and cayenne. Add the beef cubes and toss to coat well. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or overnight for best flavor.
If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, alternating with bell peppers, onion, and zucchini.
Grill skewers for 10-15 minutes, turning every 3-4 minutes, until beef is charred on the outside and cooked to your preferred doneness (medium is around 135°F).
Rest for 5 minutes, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve with rice, pita bread, or a fresh salad.

title: Beef Taco Bowl Meal Prep
description: A hearty taco bowl with seasoned ground beef, cilantro-lime rice, and all the classic fixings. Easy to batch cook and portion out for the week.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 20 min

ingredients.name: (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.original: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Cook rice in chicken broth according to package directions. Once done, fluff and stir in cilantro, lime juice, and butter.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and break apart with a spatula.
Cook beef for 5-6 minutes until browned. Drain excess fat if needed.
Add chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat.
Add water and simmer for 3-4 minutes until the seasoning forms a light sauce.
Build bowls: layer rice, seasoned beef, black beans, corn, tomatoes, avocado, cheese, and sour cream.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.

title: Braised Beef Noodle Soup with Baby Bok Choy
description: A rich and aromatic Chinese-style braised beef noodle soup with tender chuck roast, warming spices, and baby bok choy. Made easy in a pressure cooker or simmered on the stovetop.
meta: Serves: 10 | Prep Time: 30 min | Cook Time: 45 min

ingredients.name: chuck roast beef, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
ingredients.original: 4 ⅔ pounds chuck roast beef, cut into 1.5-inch cubes

ingredients.name: Salt and black pepper to season
ingredients.original: Salt and black pepper to season

ingredients.name: rock sugar or white sugar
ingredients.original: 1 ⅓ tablespoons rock sugar or white sugar

ingredients.name: Chinese spice braising packets (or make your own, see below)
ingredients.original: 1 ⅓ Chinese spice braising packets (or make your own, see below)

instructions: Slice onions and tomatoes, and mince garlic cloves.
Set the pressure cooker to saute mode and preheat on high, or turn your pan to medium-high heat.
While the pot is heating up, season the beef cubes on all sides with salt and pepper.
Add oil into the pressure cooker and add about a third of the beef. Be careful not to crowd the pot. Sear 2 sides of the beef for 2-3 minutes each.
Remove beef once browned and repeat batches until all the beef has browned. Add additional oil if needed.
If making your own spice bag, assemble it now while the beef is browning.

Once all the beef is done browning and removed, add the diced onions, tomato, and garlic into the pot. Saute for about 2 minutes, then add the Shao Xing wine to deglaze the pot. Scrape all browned bits from the bottom.

Return the browned beef to the pot and add all remaining seasonings: tomato paste, doubanjiang, fish sauce, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, bay leaves, spice packet, and dried chilis. Add the water.
Set the pressure cooker to cook on high pressure for 30 minutes, or simmer on medium to medium-low for 1 to 1.5 hours.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the garnishes and wash the baby bok choy.
Cook noodles according to package instructions. Remove from pot, then place bok choy in the same water to cook for 2 minutes.
Let the pressure cooker naturally depressurize for 10 minutes after the cooking cycle has completed, then carefully release pressure.
Ladle soup and beef over noodles, top with bok choy, cilantro, green onions, and chili oil.

title: Carne Asada (Skirt Steak)
description: Thin, charred skirt steak marinated in citrus, garlic, and Mexican spices. Perfect for tacos, burritos, or served over rice with guacamole.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 15 min + 2 hr marinating | Cook Time: 10 min
instructions: Combine orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cilantro, jalapeño, cumin, chili powder, paprika, oregano, salt, pepper, and onion powder in a bowl or zip-lock bag.
Add the skirt steak, turning to coat well. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or up to 8 hours. Do not over-marinate or the citrus will start to "cook" the meat.
Remove steak from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Drying the surface is essential for getting a good char.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill over very high heat until smoking hot. You want maximum heat for a proper sear.
Cook the steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness. Skirt steak is thin — don't walk away.
Transfer to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes. This is important — cut too soon and you lose all the juices.
Slice thinly against the grain (this is critical for skirt steak — cutting with the grain makes it chewy). Serve immediately in warm tortillas with guacamole, pico de gallo, and a squeeze of lime.

title: Best Classic Lasagna Recipe
description: The Best Classic Lasagna Recipe - Homemade lasagna full of pasta, ricotta, a homemade meat sauce, and tons of cheese. This is the world's best lasagna recipe!
meta: Serves: 12 servings | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 1 hr 30 min | Total Time: 1 hr 50 min

ingredients.name: minced fresh flat-leaf parsley, divided
ingredients.original: 1/4 cup minced fresh flat-leaf parsley, divided

ingredients.name: . (1 3/4 cups) whole milk Ricotta cheese
ingredients.original: 15 oz. (1 3/4 cups) whole milk Ricotta cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

Make the meat sauce. Add beef and sausage to a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon. Add the onion and garlic. Cook until meat is browned, about 6-8 minutes. Drain the fat from the meat. Return the meat to the skillet.

Add the tomato sauce, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar, 2 teaspoons salt, 2 teaspoons Italian seasoning, 1 teaspoon basil, and the black pepper. Stir until well combined. Cover and reduce the heat to low. Simmer the sauce for 30 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the minced parsley.

As the sauce cooks, make the ricotta mixture. In a large bowl, add 1 cup mozzarella, the ricotta, 1/4 cup parmesan, 2 tablespoons of the parsley, the egg, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and 1/2 teaspoon basil. Stir until well incorporated.
Cook the pasta al dente, according to it's package directions.

Assemble the lasagna. In a 13x9 inch baking dish, add a very thin layer of meat sauce (about 1/4 cup). Layer 3 lasagna noodles, 1/3 of the ricotta mixture, and 1 1/2 (level) cups of meat sauce. Repeat the layers twice.
Add a final layer of the remaining noodles, meat sauce, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1/4 cup parmesan.
Cover with foil that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the foil. Bake 15 more minutes.
Let the lasagna cool for 15-20 minutes before cutting.

title: Double Beef Chili
description: A hearty, meaty chili featuring both stew meat and ground beef, loaded with beans and simmered in a rich, spiced tomato sauce.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 1 hr 15 min
instructions: In a large dutch oven, brown ground beef on medium high.
When beef is browned, remove and set aside.
Add in stew meat and brown, turning to be sure it cooks evenly.
Remove stew meat when browned. Do not drain fat.
Add onion, garlic, jalapeño, to pot.
Cook on medium high until soft.
Add meat back to pot, and add spices, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, and beans, stir well to combine.
Add in beef stock, stir.
Cover with lid and simmer on low for one hour.
Top with shredded cheese, green onion, sour cream, and fritos if desired.

title: Chef John's Italian Meatballs
description: These Italian meatballs are very easy to make, and since we skip the messy step of pan-frying the meatballs, it becomes downright simple! Here a standard half-beef/half-pork mixture is used.
meta: Serves: 8 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 35 min | Additional Time: 1 hr 20 min | Total Time: 2 hrs 15 min

ingredients.name: milk or beef broth
ingredients.original: ½ cup milk or beef broth

instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Cover a baking sheet with foil and spray lightly with cooking spray. Soak bread crumbs in milk in a small bowl for 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking and stirring until onion is very tender, about 15 minutes more.

Gently stir beef and pork together in a large bowl. Add onions, bread crumb mixture, eggs, Parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic, salt, black pepper, Italian herb seasoning, and red pepper flakes; mix together using a rubber spatula until combined. Cover and refrigerate for about one hour.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Form mixture into balls about 1 ½ inches in diameter; arrange in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until browned and cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve with your favorite tomato sauce. Enjoy!

title: Lebanese Spinach, Beef & Rice
description: A comforting Lebanese one-pot dish with ground beef, frozen spinach, rice, and warm spices finished with a bright squeeze of lemon juice.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 45 min

ingredients.name: (10 ounce) packages frozen chopped spinach (drained and squeeze out all water from spinach)
ingredients.original: 3 (10 ounce) packages frozen chopped spinach (drained and squeeze out all water from spinach)

instructions: In a cooking pot, add olive oil and heat for a moment. Add onions and sauté. Add ground beef and cook until beef is brown. Add allspice, cinnamon, and salt. Mix. Add spinach and sauté with meat for a moment. Once it's all mixed well together, add water to the pot, just enough to cover the spinach. Cover and let the spinach meat mixture boil and then turn it down to medium heat and let it simmer/boil for a good 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, get a sauté pan and add some olive oil, the garlic, and the chopped cilantro and sauté' that mixture together. Add cilantro/garlic mixture to the spinach (after the spinach has cooked for 30 minutes). Cover and let it simmer for about 15 more minutes. Serve with rice and squeeze lemon juice on top!

title: Homemade Smash Burger
description: Classic smash burgers with crispy edges, melted cheese, and caramelized onions. The key is pressing the meat thin for maximum crust development.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 10 min
instructions: Create 4 even beef balls from the ground beef.
Lay a square of parchment paper and put a ball on it, then put another square on the top and smash each ball with a pot as thin as you can. Should be about 5/8 inch thick patty.
Sauté onions in a separate pan with 1/2 teaspoon of avocado oil until slightly golden.
Get a non-stick pan decently hot and slap the meat down, peeling the paper off. Then press them down a bit with the spatula all around. Cook for 3 minutes on one side and 2 minutes after flipping.

When they're browned to your liking, spoon some of the sautéed onions on and add a slice of cheese on one patty. Put another patty on top and add the remaining portion of onion, add the second slice of cheese. Cover with the lid to create steam to melt the cheese.
Have TOASTED (no debate on this) buns on the side. Let the patties rest on paper towel for 1-2 minutes to soak up the excess fat (this prevents a soggy bun!).
Put the patties on the buns, cover the buns and enjoy!

title: Teriyaki Beef
description: Tender sliced beef coated in a sticky homemade teriyaki glaze, served over steamed rice. Quick, flavorful, and far better than takeout.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 10 min (+ 30 min marinating) | Cook Time: 10 min

ingredients.name: flank steak or sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain
ingredients.original: 1 ½ pounds flank steak or sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

ingredients.name: cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
ingredients.original: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water

ingredients.name: steamed white or brown rice
ingredients.original: 3 cups steamed white or brown rice

instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a bowl.
Pour half the sauce over the sliced beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat neutral oil and sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Remove beef from marinade and pat slightly dry. Cook in a single layer in batches, searing 2-3 minutes per side. Don't overcrowd the pan.
Remove beef and set aside. Add garlic and ginger to the pan, cook 30 seconds.
Pour in the remaining teriyaki sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Return beef to the pan and toss to coat in the glaze.
Serve over steamed rice, topped with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Teriyaki Pork Tenderloin with Broccoli and Noodles
description: Juicy, caramelized teriyaki pork tenderloin served over lo mein noodles with garlicky stir-fried broccoli. A complete, satisfying meal with bold umami flavor.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 15 min + 1 hr marinating | Cook Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: lo mein or ramen noodles
ingredients.original: 8 ounces lo mein or ramen noodles

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds and sliced green onions (for garnish)
ingredients.original: Sesame seeds and sliced green onions (for garnish)

instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Reserve half the marinade for a sauce. Add the pork to the remaining marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Remove pork from marinade (discard used marinade). Heat vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over high heat. Sear the pork tenderloin on all sides, about 2 minutes per side until nicely browned.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 15-20 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 145°F. Remove and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
While the pork rests, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and toss with a little sesame oil.
In a large wok or skillet over high heat, heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil. Stir-fry the broccoli with minced garlic for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp and slightly charred.
Simmer the reserved marinade in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the cornstarch slurry and stir until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Slice the pork and serve over noodles with broccoli on the side. Drizzle with teriyaki sauce and garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

title: Grilled Corn & Veggie Bowl with Shrimp & Avocado Crema over Rice
description: A colorful, healthy bowl with grilled corn, sautéed shrimp, fresh vegetables, and creamy avocado crema over rice. Perfect for meal prep!
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: Oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika or chili flakes
ingredients.original: Oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika or chili flakes

instructions: **Cook the rice**: Prepare 2 cups uncooked rice according to package directions (makes about 6 cups cooked).
**Grill the corn**: Roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes until charred, or grill. Cut kernels off the cobs.
**Prep vegetables**: Dice all 6 mini cucumbers and 2 tomatoes. Julienne, dice, or shave the 8 carrots. Chop the butter lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
**Cook the shrimp**: Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and chili flakes/paprika. Sauté in oil over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
**Make avocado crema**: Blend 1 avocado with 3-4 tablespoons water (or lime juice), salt, and seasonings until smooth.
**Assemble 4 bowls**: Start with rice as the base. Top with corn, carrots, cucumbers, tomatoes, and chopped lettuce. Add shrimp and diced second avocado. Drizzle with avocado crema.
**Season and serve**: Add final touches like salt, pepper, lime juice, or olive oil.

title: Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai street food with flat rice noodles, shrimp or chicken, eggs, bean sprouts, and peanuts in a sweet and tangy tamarind sauce.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: uncooked shrimp, chicken, or extra-firm tofu, cut into small pieces
ingredients.original: 8 ounces uncooked shrimp, chicken, or extra-firm tofu, cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: rice vinegar, or Tamarind Paste
ingredients.original: 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, or Tamarind Paste

ingredients.name: Sriracha hot sauce, or more, to taste
ingredients.original: 1 tablespoon Sriracha hot sauce, or more, to taste

instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions, just until tender. Rinse under cold water.
Make sauce by combining sauce ingredients in a bowl. Set aside.

Stir Fry: Heat 1½ tablespoons of oil in a wok or large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp, chicken or tofu, garlic and bell pepper. The shrimp will cook quickly, about 1-2 minutes on each side, or until pink. If using chicken, cook until just cooked through, about 3-4 minutes, flipping only once.
Push everything to the side of the pan. Add a little more oil and add the beaten eggs. Scramble the eggs, breaking them into small pieces with a spatula as they cook.
Add noodles, sauce, bean sprouts and peanuts to the wok (reserving some peanuts for topping at the end). Toss everything to combine.
Garnish the top with green onions, extra peanuts, cilantro and lime wedges. Serve immediately!
Store leftovers in the fridge and enjoy within 2-3 days.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: Classic shrimp fried rice with day-old rice, scrambled eggs, mixed vegetables, and a perfect balance of soy, oyster, and sesame sauces.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: cooked rice (day-old and cold works best)
ingredients.original: 4 1/2 cups cooked rice (day-old and cold works best)

ingredients.name: -5 green onions, sliced (whites and greens separated)
ingredients.original: 4-5 green onions, sliced (whites and greens separated)

ingredients.name: Salt and white pepper to taste
ingredients.original: Salt and white pepper to taste

instructions: **Cook the shrimp**: Heat 1½ tablespoons oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Season shrimp with salt and pepper, cook 2-3 minutes until pink. Remove and set aside.
**Scramble the eggs**: Add 1½ tablespoons oil, pour in beaten eggs, scramble quickly, then remove.
**Stir-fry vegetables**: Add remaining 1½-2 tablespoons oil. Cook garlic and white parts of green onions for 30 seconds. Add mixed vegetables, stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
**Add rice**: Add cold rice, break up any clumps. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes until heated through and slightly crispy.
**Season**: Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss well.
**Combine**: Return shrimp and eggs to the wok. Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes.
**Finish**: Top with green onion tops. Serve hot!

title: Shrimp Lemon Orecchiette
description: A bright and fresh pasta dish with perfectly seared shrimp, tender arugula, lemon, and orecchiette pasta. Simple yet elegant.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 15 min

ingredients.name: g shrimp (peeled & deveined, medium or large)
ingredients.original: 300 g shrimp (peeled & deveined, medium or large)

ingredients.name: baby arugula (roughly two large handfuls)
ingredients.original: 2 cups baby arugula (roughly two large handfuls)

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes (optional, for a little heat)
ingredients.original: 1 pinch red pepper flakes (optional, for a little heat)

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook orecchiette until just al dente (they'll finish in the sauce).
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Heat 1–2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season shrimp lightly with salt and pepper.
Cook shrimp for 1–2 minutes per side until just pink. Remove and set aside.
Lower heat to medium. Add another drizzle of olive oil.
Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes. Sauté for about 30 seconds — just until fragrant (don't burn the garlic).
Pour in the lemon juice and zest, scraping any bits from the pan.
Add a splash of reserved pasta water (start with ¼ cup) to loosen things up.
Toss it all together.
Add drained pasta into the skillet. Stir until the pasta soaks up the sauce.
Return shrimp to the pan. Toss again.
Add arugula right at the end — it should wilt gently in the heat of the pasta.
Plate it up and grate Parmesan on top (optional but amazing).

title: Small Greek Salad
description: A classic Greek salad with crisp romaine, fresh vegetables, and tangy feta cheese in a simple red wine vinegar dressing.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min
instructions: Combine all vegetables in a bowl.
Whisk together olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Toss salad with dressing, divide between two plates, and top with crumbled feta.

title: Authentic Hawaiian Macaroni Salad
description: Creamy, tangy Hawaiian-style macaroni salad with a mayo base, apple cider vinegar, shredded carrots and onion. Must be refrigerated for at least 4 hours to develop the signature flavor.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min (+ 4 hrs chilling) | Cook Time: 10 min

ingredients.name: mayonnaise (Best Foods or Hellman's mayonnaise - no substitutes!)
ingredients.original: 2 1/2 cups mayonnaise (Best Foods or Hellman's mayonnaise - no substitutes!)

instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Rinse under cold water until completely cool. Drain well and place in a large bowl.
Sprinkle on vinegar. Add carrot and onion. Toss together until well combined. Refrigerate for 15 minutes, or until cooled.
In a separate, small bowl, whisk together mayo, milk, and sugar. Fold the mayo mixture into the macaroni until all the noodles are evenly coated. Add salt and pepper to taste.
**Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (best if overnight).**
Gently stir before serving, add a little more milk if needed, no more than a tablespoon or two.

title: Lebanese Tabbouleh Salad
description: A bright, fresh Lebanese salad dominated by curly parsley, mint, tomatoes, and fine bulgur wheat, dressed in lemon and olive oil. The real deal — mostly herbs, not grain.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 20 min + 30 min resting | Cook Time: 0 min

ingredients.name: bunches curly parsley, finely chopped (about 3 cups)
ingredients.original: 3 large bunches curly parsley, finely chopped (about 3 cups)

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
ingredients.original: 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, finely chopped

instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry the parsley (wet parsley makes soggy tabbouleh). Pick the leaves from the stems and chop very finely — almost to a mince.
Finely dice the tomatoes. Let them sit in a strainer for a few minutes to drain excess juice.
In a large bowl, combine the parsley, tomatoes, green onions, and mint.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, and allspice. Toss well to combine.

Add the dry bulgur wheat and toss to combine. Let the salad rest for 15-20 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the bulgur to soften slightly from the dressing. Taste and adjust lemon, salt, or olive oil as needed. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Micro Chop Kale Salad
description: A vibrant kale salad with finely chopped greens, toasted pine nuts and panko, creamy avocado, and a honey-dijon dressing. Massaging the kale softens it into a tender, non-tough base.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 5 min

ingredients.name: curly kale, stems removed and very finely chopped
ingredients.original: 1 bunch curly kale, stems removed and very finely chopped

instructions: **Why?** Because the kale softens and isn't a tough ball of roughage that we all tend to think of when we think of kale!
First, remove stems from the kale and chop it very finely.
Transfer the chopped kale to a large bowl and add the avocado oil.
Use your hands to massage the kale for about 1 minute, to soften.
Chop the avocado and jalapenos and add to the bowl, along with the grated cheese.
Next, in a small pan over medium-low heat, toast the pine nuts for about 3-4 minutes then add in the breadcrumbs and toast for 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat and transfer to the bowl with the salad.
Add the dressing ingredients to a small blender and blend until creamy.
Pour over the top of the salad.
Add the lemon zest.
Toss and enjoy!

title: Protein Cornbread
description: A healthier take on classic cornbread with added protein powder, Greek yogurt, and reduced sugar. Perfect alongside chili or as a snack.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 20 min
instructions: Turn your rolled oats into flour by processing or blending them.
Take out a bowl and mix all of your ingredients together.
Coat a baking dish with some non-stick cooking spray.
Pour your mix in.
Bake on 425F/218C for 15-20 minutes.

title: Quinoa Tabbouleh
description: A Lebanese-inspired tabbouleh using quinoa instead of bulgur wheat, with abundant fresh parsley, vegetables, and a bright lemon-pomegranate dressing.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 15 min (quinoa)
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package directions and let cool completely.
Finely chop the parsley, scallions, cucumber, and tomato.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa with all the chopped vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon zest, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, olive oil, and salt.
Pour the dressing over the quinoa mixture and toss well to combine.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Roasted Little Potatoes
description: Perfectly crispy roasted potatoes with golden edges and fluffy interiors. Simple seasoning lets the natural potato flavor shine through.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: garlic powder (or onion powder, or a mix)
ingredients.original: ½ teaspoon garlic powder (or onion powder, or a mix)

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Halve the potatoes (or quarter if they're larger). Toss in a bowl with olive oil, garlic/onion powder, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer, cut side down.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and crispy on the edges. They should be fork-tender inside.

title: Adas Bil Hamod (Lebanese Lentil & Lemon Soup)
description: A classic Middle Eastern lentil stew that's both hearty and tangy, featuring tender lentils simmered in a broth of fresh herbs, chard, aromatic spices and fresh lemon juice. Vibrant, comforting, and nutritious.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 50 min | Total Time: 1 hr 5 min
instructions: Add 3 tablespoons of the oil to a casserole and pre-heat over medium-low heat. Finely dice the onion and add to the casserole. Cut the leaves off the Swiss chard. Roughly chop the leaves and set aside, then finely dice the stems. Add the stems to the onion and continue cooking until both have softened.

In the meantime, trim and discard the lower stems of the coriander and roughly chop the rest. Dice the potatoes into 1cm pieces and give the lentils a quick rinse under the tap. When the onions and stems are soft, stir in the cumin and black pepper to heat it through, then tip the lentils into the pan along with the potatoes, coriander and 1.5l of water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat and simmer covered for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Add the chard leaves and salt and simmer for another 10 minutes until the lentils and potatoes are fully cooked.

Meanwhile, measure out the lemon juice. Then peel and finely grate the garlic. Pre-heat the remaining 4 tablespoons of olive oil in a small frying pan and sauté the garlic and dried mint until the garlic is golden. Add this to the soup along with the lemon juice. Turn off the heat, give it a stir, then divide over bowls and serve with a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and some bread.

title: Protein Pizza
description: A high-protein air fryer pizza with a crispy Greek yogurt crust. Only 630 calories for the entire pizza with 61g of protein.
meta: Serves: 1 | Prep Time: 5 min | Cook Time: 9 min

ingredients.name: g PEScience Select multi-purpose protein powder
ingredients.original: 30 g PEScience Select multi-purpose protein powder

instructions: Add all the dry ingredients (flour, protein, and seasoning) to a large bowl and mix. Add the Greek yogurt to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.

Generously flour a clean surface and add your dough. Add more flour over the top of the dough and use your hands to press the dough out into a pizza shape, leaving the crust slightly thicker. You can use your air fryer basket as reference for how large to make the pizza.
Preheat your air fryer at 400°F for a few minutes, then spray with cooking spray and add your formed pizza dough. Poke holes in the center of the dough with a fork to prevent it from bubbling up.

Spray the dough with cooking spray, then season the outer crust with garlic powder (optional). Air fry at 400°F for 5 minutes, then carefully flip the pizza dough and air fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Flip the dough back in the air fryer, then add your sauce and cheese.
Air fry for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and browned to your liking.
Top with Italian seasoning, cut into 6 slices, and enjoy.

title: Deconstructed Stuffed Zucchini with Brown Butter Pine Nuts
description: All the flavors of stuffed zucchini without the tedious hollowing! Zucchini boats filled with spiced ground lamb, marinara sauce, and topped with golden brown butter pine nuts.
meta: Serves: 2 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 30 min
instructions: Chop the onion and brown it in some butter.
Cut the zucchinis in half and scoop out the flesh, keeping it in a bowl separately.
Mash the zucchini flesh and add marinara sauce, chicken stock, salt, and baharat, then mix together.
Pour the sauce into the bottom of a baking dish.
Place the hollowed out zucchinis into the pan and fork them to make them tender.
Add lamb to the pan with the onions and cook with salt and baharat for about five to six minutes.
Olive oil the zucchinis and scoop the lamb mixture into each zucchini boat.
Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake in the oven for about 25 minutes, removing the foil for the last five minutes.
In a separate pan, heat butter and add pine nuts, mixing until they are golden brown.

title: French Toast
description: Brioche and challah bread make the best French toast. Both are already so eggy that once dipped in the batter and griddled in butter they become custard-like on the inside with a nicely browned and caramelized outside.
meta: Serves: 4 | Prep Time: 20 min | Cook Time: 10 min | Total Time: 30 min

ingredients.name: challah, brioche, or white bread
ingredients.original: 8 slices challah, brioche, or white bread

instructions: In a small bowl, combine cinnamon, nutmeg, and sugar and set aside briefly.
In a 10-inch or 12-inch skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk together cinnamon mixture, eggs, milk, and vanilla and pour into a shallow container such as a pie plate.
Dip bread in egg mixture. Fry slices until golden brown, then flip to cook the other side. Serve with syrup.

title: Good Old-Fashioned Pancakes
description: A classic family recipe for fluffy, perfectly golden pancakes. This was found in Grandma's recipe book and judging from the weathered look of the card, it was a family favorite.
meta: Serves: 8 | Prep Time: 5 min | Cook Time: 15 min | Total Time: 20 min

ingredients.name: salt, or more to taste
ingredients.original: ¼ teaspoon salt, or more to taste

instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Sift flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl. Make a well in the center and add milk, melted butter, and egg; mix until smooth.

Heat a lightly oiled griddle or pan over medium-high heat. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake; cook until bubbles form and the edges are dry, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Flip and cook until browned on the other side. Repeat with remaining batter.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Banana Banana Bread
description: This banana bread recipe creates the most delicious, moist loaf with loads of banana flavor. Friends and family say it's by far the best! It tastes wonderful toasted.
meta: Serves: 12 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 1 hr | Total Time: 1 hr 15 min
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.

Combine flour, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. Beat brown sugar and butter with an electric mixer in a separate large bowl until smooth. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended. Stir banana mixture into flour mixture until just combined.
Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 60 minutes.
Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
Enjoy!

title: Crispy Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: These chocolate chip cookies are crispy on the outside and still gooey in the middle. The dough is thicker than typical recipes, creating the perfect texture combination.
meta: Serves: 36 cookies | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 15 min
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sift flour, baking soda and salt together, set aside.

Using an electric mixer, cream together the butter and sugars until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg, then add the vanilla. Mix in the dry ingredients until well blended, then stir in the chocolate chips. Using a small cookie scoop (approximately 2 tablespoons) drop the dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 14-15 minutes. Allow the cookies to cool a few minutes before transferring to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Italian Ricotta Cookies Recipe
description: These Italian Ricotta Cookies are soft, sweet, and topped with almond glaze and sprinkles - a festive treat perfect for any occasion!
meta: Serves: 60 cookies | Prep Time: 10 min | Cook Time: 10 min | Inactive Time: 10 min | Total Time: 30 min
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or use ungreased baking sheets.
In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs, ricotta cheese, and vanilla extract until fully combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing just until incorporated.
Scoop or roll dough into teaspoon-sized balls and place about 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden. Let cool on the baking sheet for 3 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, powdered sugar, and almond extract until smooth.
Dip the tops of cooled cookies into the glaze and return to the wire rack.
Immediately top with non-pareils or sprinkles before the glaze sets.

title: My Favorite Spritz Cookies
description: These are my favorite spritz cookies! Using a cookie press, shape this easy cookie dough into intricate shapes and have fun decorating with sprinkles, chocolate, and chocolate chips. No cookie dough chilling required and they freeze and ship wonderfully.
meta: Serves: 84 bite-size cookies | Prep Time: 30 min | Cook Time: 30 min | Total Time: 1 hr

ingredients.name: (16 tablespoons; 226g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
ingredients.original: 1 cup (16 tablespoons; 226g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature

ingredients.name: Optional: gel food coloring, sprinkles, chocolate chips, and melted chocolate for decorating
ingredients.original: Optional: gel food coloring, sprinkles, chocolate chips, and melted chocolate for decorating

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line 2 or 3 large baking sheets with silicone baking mats, or use nonstick baking sheets with no liner. (Do not use parchment paper because the cookie dough, when pressed out of the cookie press, will not adhere to it.) While the oven is preheating, and if your refrigerator or freezer has room, it's helpful to chill your lined baking sheets. It sounds odd, but dough coming out of the cookie press adheres much better to a cold surface.

Make the dough: In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer or a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter and granulated sugar together on medium-high speed until smooth, about 3 minutes. Add the egg, vanilla extract, and almond extract, and beat on high speed until combined, about 1 minute. Scrape down the sides and up the bottom of the bowl and beat again as needed to combine.
On low speed, beat in the flour and salt. Turn up to high speed and beat until completely combined.

Press the dough: Follow cookie press manufacturer's directions to fit your cookie press with a decorative plate. Scrape some of the dough into your cookie press. Hold the cookie press perpendicular to the cold lined baking sheet and press out the cookies 2 inches (5 cm) apart. If desired, decorate the shaped cookie dough with sprinkles or press a chocolate chip into the center. Note: It's helpful to lightly brush the shaped cookie dough with water before adding sprinkles—this helps them stick.
If the cookie dough becomes too soft as you work, chill the shaped cookie dough in the refrigerator for 10 minutes before baking.
Bake until very lightly browned on the edges, 7–9 minutes.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. If desired, drizzle with melted chocolate.
Cookies stay fresh in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Truly Crispy Oven Baked Buffalo Wings
description: This recipe uses a genius technique discovered by Cook's Illustrated to make chicken wings in the oven that come out so crispy that it's hard to believe they aren't deep fried. Tossed in a classic Buffalo sauce and served with blue cheese dip and celery.
meta: Serves: 8 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 1 hr 10 min | Total Time: 1 hr 25 min

ingredients.name: baking powder (NOT baking soda / bi-carb soda)
ingredients.original: 5 teaspoons baking powder (NOT baking soda / bi-carb soda)

ingredients.name: kosher salt / cooking salt (not table salt, too fine)
ingredients.original: 3/4 teaspoons kosher salt / cooking salt (not table salt, too fine)

ingredients.name: Frank's Original Red Hot Sauce
ingredients.original: 1/2 cup Frank's Original Red Hot Sauce

ingredients.name: crumbled blue cheese, softened (I use gorgonzola)
ingredients.original: 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese, softened (I use gorgonzola)

instructions: Dry overnight (optional) - If you plan ahead, lay the wings on a rack on a rimmed baking tray and let them dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Alternatively, pat them dry with paper towels.
Preheat the oven to 250°F/120°C (all oven types). Put one oven shelf in the lower quarter of the oven and one in the top quarter.
Line the tray with foil. Put a rack on the tray then spray the rack with oil.
Toss wings - Place the wings in a large bowl. Sprinkle over baking powder and salt. Use hands to toss well (or shake in ziplock bag) to coat wings evenly.
Bake 30 minutes on low temp - Place the wings skin side up on the rack (ok if snug, they shrink). Bake on the lower shelf in the oven for 30 minutes.

Bake 40 minutes on high - Move the tray up to the higher shelf and turn the oven up to 425°F / 220°C (all oven types). Bake for a further 40 to 50 minutes, rotating the tray halfway through. The wings do not need to be turned over. They are ready when dark golden brown and the skin is very crispy.
Toss in sauce - Transfer the wings into a large bowl. Pour over sauce and toss to coat. (Alternatively, serve wings plain with Buffalo Sauce for dipping).
Serve immediately with Blue Cheese Dip (for both wings and celery sticks dunking)!
Whisk together the Sauce ingredients until the sugar is melted. Keep warm or reheat just prior to using.
Mash the blue cheese with sour cream until smooth (or to your taste).
Add remaining ingredients and mix well until combined, using milk to get it to the consistency you want. Store in the fridge until required. Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lebanese Hummus
description: Ultra-smooth, creamy Lebanese-style hummus made from scratch with chickpeas, tahini, and lemon. Far better than anything from a store.
meta: Serves: 6 | Prep Time: 15 min | Cook Time: 0 min

ingredients.original: 3-4 tablespoons ice cold water (or reserved chickpea liquid)

instructions: Add the chickpeas, garlic, and salt to a food processor. Process for about 1 minute until finely ground, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add the tahini and blend for another minute until well combined and smooth.
Add the lemon juice and process for 30 seconds.
With the processor running, slowly drizzle in ice-cold water one tablespoon at a time until you reach your desired consistency — smooth, light, and creamy.
Taste and adjust lemon juice and salt. Process for another 30 seconds.
Spread into a wide bowl, creating a shallow well in the center. Drizzle generously with olive oil, sprinkle with paprika, and top with fresh parsley. Serve with warm pita or vegetables.
